# Awesome Jev

A community directory of Jev open-source and publicly available source projects. Source checks are not runtime, performance or security certification. License status is listed per project.

Website: https://logicrw.github.io/awesome-jev-projects/
Repository: https://github.com/logicrw/awesome-jev-projects
Catalog entries: 261

## Install the Agent Skill

```bash
npx skills add logicrw/awesome-jev-projects
npx skills add https://logicrw.github.io/awesome-jev-projects/
```
